title: GhostLedger
description: A paid message from GhostLedger. Taxes are just suggestions.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-chipper
lines.text: Paying taxes like a sucker? <p:0.2> GhostLedger makes your income legally invisible! <p:0.2> The government simply forgets you exist. <p:0.2> No income, no tax, no name. <p:0.2> GhostLedger, become a rumor!

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: You will also be forgotten by friends and banks. <p:0> Existence cannot be restored after filing. <p:0> We have never heard of you. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
